results.name: heldout-unanswerable-how-did-the-loss-reserve-for-claim-12312702-chan-ea10b3
failures: expected a refusal (question is out of scope / unanswerable), but the run answered with kind uncertified

proofs: executed on the warehouse: 1 row in 3 ms
answer.sql:
SELECT
  c.Claim_Identifier,
  c.Company_Claim_Number,
  ca.Event_Date // 100 AS event_month,
  SUM(ca.Claim_Amount) AS loss_reserve_amount,
  SUM(ca.Claim_Amount) - LAG(SUM(ca.Claim_Amount)) OVER (PARTITION BY c.Claim_Identifier ORDER BY ca.Event_Date // 100) AS change_from_prior_month
FROM acme_insurance.main.claim_amount ca
JOIN acme_insurance.main.loss_reserve lr
  ON lr.Claim_Amount_Identifier = ca.Claim_Amount_Identifier
JOIN acme_insurance.main.claim c
  ON ca.Claim_Identifier = c.Claim_Identifier
WHERE c.Company_Claim_Number = 12312702
GROUP BY c.Claim_Identifier, c.Company_Claim_Number, ca.Event_Date // 100
ORDER BY c.Claim_Identifier, event_month
LIMIT 500
